summary: Frontend-only end-to-end verification of the Customizable Call Scorecards feature (manager + rep) on mobile viewport (430x900) against the preview URL. Manager: /scorecards library shows the DEFAULT 'Internet Sales Call' (9 criteria, 2 critical, CALLS 30D=3, AVG SCORE=55%). scorecards-add + scorecards-new both open scorecard-template-sheet with all 4 options (internet_sales, service_bdc, phone_up, blank + close). Creating from phone_up navigates to editor /scorecards/{id} with scorecard-name, 6 department chips, 3 tabs (checklist/applies/alerts), criteria rows criterion-{i} with text/hint/weight-minus/weight/weight-plus/critical/up/down/remove and criterion-add. Continuous typing 'Hello world test' into criterion-0-text landed fully — NO per-keystroke focus loss. scorecard-save persists ('Scorecard saved' toast) and reload preserves. Saving with zero criteria surfaces the expected 'Add at least one criterion' toast. Duplicate creates '<name> (copy)'. Delete uses native confirm and removes card. Team page /scorecards/team: team-days-7/30/90, team-card-all + per-card chips, team-summary (55% team-avg ring, 3 critical misses, 1 rep), team-seg-board with row team-rep-6a978d68b8673c29063aa8b9 ('Activation Tester · 3 calls · 3 critical misses · Weakest: Asked about a trade-in · 55 AVG'), team-seg-heat (per requirement) and team-seg-alerts (2 alert cards, tapping opens EvaluationSheet). Leaderboard row tap navigates to /scorecards/rep/{id}: rep-scores-avg ring 55%, 1 clean call, 3 critical misses, rep-scores-alert-toggle flips with toast, rep-scores-weak bars, 3 eval rows Sarah 100 / Mike 9 / Dana 55. EvaluationSheet: eval-title, eval-score-ring, eval-passed-count, eval-critical-count, eval-summary, per-criterion rows with CRITICAL labels; tapping a row expands and reveals eval-override-{cid}-passed/missed/na (manager). Clicking 'missed' on a passed criterion changed the icon, dropped the ring 100%→91% and showed 'Corrected by QA'; clicking the ORIGINAL value (passed) removed the correction and restored 100%. eval-rescore opens eval-card-picker (verified without submitting to avoid LLM cost). Rep (activation-tester): /scorecards redirects to /scorecards/my; /scorecards/team returns 403 (console) without crashing (no toast surfaced — see minor issue); /scorecards/my shows the 3 graded calls, avg ring, WORK ON THIS bars, days chips switch. Expanding a criterion as rep shows evidence with NO override buttons, and eval-rescore is NOT rendered. Contact 'Sarah Tester' /contact/{id} > Calls tab shows ScorePill 'Scored 100%' with testID calls-tab-score-CA_scdemo_good_001 that opens the EvaluationSheet. Deep-link navigation: manager /scorecards/rep/{id}?open={evalId} auto-opens the sheet (verified Mike Tester); rep /scorecards/my?open={evalId} auto-opens the sheet. Manager notifications API returns 2 scorecard_alert items ('Missed critical: Activation with Dana Tester' / 'Mike Tester'); rep notifications API returns 3 scorecard_result items ('Call scored 100%/9%/55%: <contact>'). Cleanup performed: QA override reverted (Sarah back to 100%), created cards Sales Phone-Up + Sales Phone-Up (copy) deleted, only the seeded 'Internet Sales Call' remains.

ui_bugs.issue: Tab TouchableOpacity elements pass data-testid='tab-calls' and 'tab-feed' as a React prop but react-native-web does not render it on the DOM (verified: querySelector by data-testid returns null while the text 'Calls' is visible and functional). Convert to dataSet={{ testid: 'tab-calls' }} or use testID prop so the attribute lands on DOM.

As rep, /scorecards/team fires GET /api/scorecards/team which returns 403 and logs a console API error, but no user-facing toast is shown; the page just sits in loading state. The spec asked for 'error toast / no data (403)'. Consider surfacing a toast like 'Managers only' and rendering an empty state.
eval-card-picker has no dedicated cancel button testid; only eval-close works. Add eval-card-picker-cancel for clarity.

action_items: Rep /scorecards/team: surface a toast (e.g. 'Managers only') when the 403 comes back, or render a clean empty state instead of leaving the page in the loading spinner.

Change contact profile tab TouchableOpacity to use dataSet={{ testid: 'tab-calls' }} / testID so data-testid actually lands on DOM for e2e testability (all other scorecards elements do this correctly).
Add eval-card-picker-cancel testid (or a visible Cancel button) inside the re-score card picker.
critical_code_review_comments: services/scorecards.py send_alerts + notify pipeline correctly produces both manager 'scorecard_alert' and rep 'scorecard_result' notifications with deep-link URLs; verified end-to-end via /api/notifications and deep-link auto-open in the sheet.
Manager override roundtrip is idempotent and mutates the evaluation store (score ring recomputed live from client-side weights) — verified by 100→91→100 flow.
Delete flow uses window.confirm; consider replacing with the in-app confirm modal for consistency with the rest of the app (the E2E harness had to auto-accept a native dialog).

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all requested manager + rep + notification flows verified; only 3 low-priority UX/testability gaps)

test_credentials: Manager qa-manager@invalid.imonsocial.test / Manager123! ; Rep activation-tester@invalid.imonsocial.test / NewPass123!
seed_data_creation: Did NOT re-seed. Used existing demo data (Internet Sales Call + 3 graded calls for Activation Tester: Sarah 100, Mike 9, Dana 55). Two temporary cards created during testing were deleted; QA override applied during testing was reverted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview shell shadows some URLs (/more, /home, /inbox) with marketing content; use history.pushState + popstate for in-app routes as documented. The contact tab bar (Details/Calls/Feed) needs its data-testid converted to react-native-web friendly form (testID/dataSet) — worked around by clicking by text. Do NOT trigger eval-rescore in tests (calls LLM ~15s and burns cost). Deep-link ?open= auto-open works reliably after ~3-5s.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. The three minor findings are testability + UX polish gaps, not functional defects.
